definitions.gloss: victory podium; medal podium; awards platform
definitions.explanation: The raised platform where winners of a competition stand to receive their medals or prizes. Has three levels for first, second, and third place.

examples.japanese: {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{立|た}つ。
{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}の{一番|いちばん}{上|うえ}に{立|た}ちたい。
examples.english: I want to stand at the top of the podium.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{三回|さんかい}{連続|れんぞく}で{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: She stood on the podium three times in a row.

notes:
{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい} is the victory podium where top finishers stand to receive medals or prizes. Composed of {表彰|ひょうしょう} (commendation) + {台|だい} (platform).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{立|た}つ: to stand on the podium
- {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{上|あ}がる: to get on the podium (= finish in top 3)
- {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}を{逃|のが}す: to miss the podium (= finish 4th or lower)
- {表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}の{一番|いちばん}{上|うえ}: the top of the podium (= 1st place)

USAGE:
In sports contexts, "{表彰台|ひょうしょうだい}に{上|あ}がる" is idiomatically used to mean finishing in the top three, not just literally stepping onto the podium.

RELATED WORDS:
- {表彰|ひょうしょう}: commendation, award ceremony
- {表彰式|ひょうしょうしき}: award ceremony
- メダル: medal
